title: How to layout your entertainment space

facts.fact: The vendor's blog says a fence of 1.2 metres around an attraction is high enough that children cannot see over it.
facts.quote: Ie if your fence around an attraction is 1.2M, kids can’t see over it, so consider using some glass windows/separations

facts.fact: In its illustrative site-line example, the vendor's blog says a staff counter placed in one spot would be unable to see 3 of the attractions.
facts.quote: with the counter unable to see 3 of your attractions!

facts.fact: The vendor's blog says layout planning should cover guests from the height of a child up to a 6 foot adult.
facts.quote: from the height of a child to a 6 foot adult

facts.fact: The vendor's blog post 'How to layout your entertainment space' was published on February 15, 2022.
The vendor's blog lists the post's reading time as 2 minutes.
